projects.name: LawLens
projects.description: Designed to simplify complex legal matters for everyday users. Whether it's a confusing clause in a contract or a general legal concern, LawLens delivers actionable insights, contextual Reddit wisdom, and intelligent document analysis.

projects.name: MediVault
projects.description: A Web3 patient sovereign medical ledger that secures your biological history on an immutable blockchain, granting you absolute ownership of your health data.It eliminates the fragmentation of traditional healthcare systems by unifying medical records into a single, decentralized vault.

projects.name: Sentient
projects.description:
An autonomous AI 'Chief of Staff' that actively manages your digital life. Sentient connects your Inbox and Calendar with a long-term memory engine to autonomously schedule meetings, resolve conflicts, and draft emails based on your historical preferences. 

 Note: This is a production-grade prototype. Login is restricted to test accounts only. Made for an Internship hiring challenge.

projects.name: Prompt Tune
projects.description: Intelligent web tool designed to bridge the gap between human ideas and AI understanding. It leverages a powerful AI engine to transform simple or vague user prompts into well-structured, effective queries for better results from any LLM.

projects.name: Portfolio
projects.description: My personal corner of the internet, built from scratch to showcase my work. Featuring a custom interactive guestbook with GitHub sign-in, a drawable signature pad, and an AI chatbot ready to answer questions. It is a full-stack application deployed globally on the edge.
